name: Decathlon Half Marathon 2026 (Cebu)
short_description: The Decathlon Half Marathon 2026 is a multi-distance road race held on September 26, 2026 at SM City Cebu, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Decathlon Half Marathon 2026 is a road race scheduled for September 26, 2026 at SM City Cebu in Cebu City, Philippines. Organized by Decathlon, the event offers four distance options: 21.1km, 15km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runner abilities. Registration details have not yet been announced. Runners interested in this Philippines-based race can look forward to more information as it becomes available.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 15km, 10km, 5km) suit different runner levels
Held at a well-known, accessible venue, SM City Cebu
Backed by an established organizer, Decathlon
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
research_highlights: The 2026 edition offers four distances: 5KM, 10KM, 15KM, and 21KM, based at SM City Cebu.
Regular registration rates are 600 for 5KM, 800 for 10KM, 1300 for 15KM, and 1600 for the 21KM half marathon.
The race is scheduled for September 26, 2026, following prior editions held in late September (e.g., September 28, 2025) at SM City Cebu Kaohsiung Street.
Race kits for the 2025 edition were distributed at the Decathlon store in SM City Cebu in the days before the event.
